description: Bicycle Infrastructure is a dataset listed in City of Providence open data portal (performance.providenceri.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Providence. This dataset tracks miles of bicycle infrastructure by type. Off-road bike paths are measured in total miles, and on-road bike lanes are measured in lane-miles. Coverage: Providence. The portal files it under the category Sustainability. The table has 5 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Providence Department of Planning and Development. The portal shows 2019-01-02 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-performance-providenceri-gov-portal.
